description: This file implements thread sampling and signal handling for thread profiling, including managing signal handlers, semaphores, and thread context freezing/thawing.

classes.name: SignalHandler
classes.description: Manages signal handling for thread profiling, including adding/removing samplers, installing/restoring signal handlers, and handling profiler signals.

methods.name: AddSampler
methods.description: Increments sampler count and installs signal handler if first sampler.

methods.name: RemoveSampler
methods.description: Decrements sampler count and restores previous signal handler if no samplers remain.

methods.name: Freeze
methods.description: Freezes a thread by sending SIGPROF and capturing its context.

methods.name: HandleProfilerSignal
methods.description: Handles SIGPROF signal to capture thread context and synchronize freeze/thaw.
